718:t_1:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「So you've confined $$サクリファイ$$ in the dimensional prison.」

718:t_1:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「We finally got all four of us together for the first time in 12,000 years, and it's no fun...」

718:t_1:7.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「But that is the only way to punish her.」

718:t_1:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Exactly. After all, 120 million years ago we cast aside all conflict and were reborn as the four $$御使い$$s.」

718:t_1:9.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「The days when we were lowly life forms who hurt one another and took each other's lives are long, long past...」

718:t_1:10.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「That is why, on that day 12,000 years ago, we sought to resolve matters by going our separate ways.」

718:t_1:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I accepted that as well.」

718:t_1:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That's precisely why, as the great collapse of the universe that comes once every 120 million years drew near, I returned to your side with $$ヘリオース$$.」

718:t_1:13.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「So what are you going to do about those lowly creatures who barged into $$カオス・コスモス$$ and are even showing signs of $$シンカ$$?」

718:t_1:14.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$テンプティ$$... What do you want to do?」

718:t_1:15.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Whatever's fun. We can let those kids swim around like this, or we can squish them flat.」

718:t_1:17.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We cannot allow them to exist.」

718:t_1:18.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Then with two votes for annihilation, one to defer, and one abstention, we will annihilate them.」

718:t_1:19.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Are you sure, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$? You doted on those kids, didn't you?」

718:t_1:20.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I am an $$御使い$$. I have no intention of letting personal feelings interfere with my mission.」

718:t_1:21.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Although I suppose our emotions can't really be called individual ones.」

718:t_1:22.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「The foreign bodies that entered $$カオス・コスモス$$ are not only the Earthlings of that world.」

718:t_1:23.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You mean the evil gods. Those guys... they're truly a calamity for the universe.」

718:t_1:24.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Depending on the circumstances, we will have to deal with them as well.」

718:t_1:25.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But first, the annihilation of the Earthlings. They're getting closer to the dimensional prison.」

718:t_1:26.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You mean $$サクリファイ$$ broke through the barrier and called those kids here...!?」

718:t_1:27.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「$$ハマリエル$$ is among them. It must be the result of her $$悲しみの乙女$$ resonating with the sorrow of $$サクリファイ$$.」

718:t_1:28.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You could even call this an opportunity the $$黒い太陽#sol$$ has led us to. If we annihilate the Earthlings before her eyes, she will probably change her mind.」

718:t_1:29.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Indeed. Once she remembers her role as an $$御使い$$, we can become one again under our mission.」

718:t_1:30.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Then let $$テンプティ$$ handle the Earthlings. $$ドクトリン$$ has adjustments to make on $$プロディキウム$$, and that needs $$ヘリオース$$ too, right?」

718:t_1:31.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Very well, $$テンプティ$$. Go and enjoy yourself to your heart's content.」

718:t_1:32.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Just thinking about it gets me all excited! I wonder how hard those kids will fight back!」

718:t_2:5.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「My name is $$哀しみのサクリファイ$$... I am one of those who call themselves $$御使い$$s.」

718:t_2:6.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$ハマリエル・ザ・スター$$... Thank you for answering my call.」

718:t_2:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「My name is $$セツコ・オハラ$$. Please call me $$セツコ$$.」

718:t_2:8.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「That I cannot do.」

718:t_2:10.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「You are a $$スフィア・リアクター$$... That means walking a destiny that has already been decided.」

718:t_2:11.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「We follow that path, and give the Reactors their names.」

718:t_2:13.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「The Star in your name is a star shining in the heavens... Your destiny is to shine only in solitude, after losing those who are close and dear to you...」

718:t_2:15.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$ウェルキエル・ザ・ヒート$$... You are steel being tempered...」

718:t_2:16.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「By enduring hardship you take on heat, and that heat turns into strength.」

718:t_2:17.en:
$$メール$$
「That's the same as Darling's nickname...!」

718:t_2:18.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「I can't believe that's a coincidence.」

718:t_2:20.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$ズリエル・ジ・アンブレイカブル$$... You are...」

718:t_2:21.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Stop right there. I've got no interest in horoscopes.」

718:t_2:22.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「From your point of view, the future... in other words, fate, may seem uncertain, but it is something that has been decided in advance.」

718:t_2:23.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「To set it in motion, I carved the $$烙印$$ into you.」

718:t_2:25.en:
$$シャア$$
「The way you put it... Are you saying this was your own doing, not that of the $$御使い$$s?」

718:t_2:27.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Before I explain the meaning of that act, let me tell you about our existence... about the $$御使い$$s.」

718:t_2:28.en:
$n
「So the time has finally come to learn what they really are...」

718:t_2:29.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「We are the species that, first among all universes, touched the $$オリジン・ロー$$ and the truth and underwent $$シンカ$$ into higher-dimensional life forms.」

718:t_2:30.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「That was 120 million years ago.」

718:t_2:31.en:
$$タケル$$
(So the $$御使い$$s use Earth's units too...)

718:t_2:32.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「And as our duty, we took on the role of guiding the species that would one day awaken as higher-dimensional life forms.」

718:t_2:33.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So that is the mission of higher-dimensional life forms...」

718:t_2:34.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「That is correct. All of it is to fill this universe with truth.」

718:t_2:35.en:
$$キラ$$
「Is that why you watched over various stars, Earth included?」

718:t_2:36.en:
$$シン$$
「What truth!? What you're doing is nothing but domination!」

718:t_2:37.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「We had no choice...」

718:t_2:38.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Contrary to our wishes, the species that awakened to the truth were not very many.」

718:t_2:39.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Worse still, some evolved in distorted ways and spread conflict throughout this universe.」

718:t_2:40.en:
$$万丈$$
「So that is why you began managing evolution?」

718:t_2:41.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「It was the most efficient way to lead a species to $$シンカ$$.」

718:t_2:42.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see... And you designated anything that evolved in a way you did not approve of as an enemy?」

718:t_2:43.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Is that the same logic behind making the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s out to be $$バアル$$?」

718:t_2:44.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Doing so is the mission of those who have awakened as higher-dimensional life forms.」

718:t_2:45.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「We followed it, and guided every universe.」

718:t_2:46.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「With the collapse that comes once every 12,000 years, the universe is reborn, and each time new species arise... We guide them, and welcome the next 12,000 years...」

718:t_2:47.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Different lives are born in different universes, evolve in different ways, and each tries to overcome the collapse of its universe...」

718:t_2:48.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Through this repetition, the cycle of the universe has turned.」

718:t_2:49.en:
$$葵$$
「You talk like you're the producer of the universe.」

718:t_2:50.en:
$$勝平$$
「Just because you were the first to undergo $$シンカ$$, do you have any right to destroy a whole galaxy!?」

718:t_2:51.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「...That is a fair point...」
